service.name: device-studio
service.description: Create reproducible photographic and 3D device presentations from authentic app captures, qualified device models and saved shot recipes.

descriptors.label: Vrooli desktop account link
descriptors.description: Signed, scoped desktop link lease stored by the credential owner; it is not an inference bearer token.

descriptors.label: Vrooli credits session for AI Gateway
descriptors.description: Only provisioned after an explicit desktop-owner choice to share the signed-in LPBS session with AI Gateway. The token is never exposed to the Device Studio renderer or API.

database.rationale: Durable Device Studio project, job, note, and capability state in the scenario-owned SQLite database.

budget.rationale: Measured at 40,960 bytes on 2026-10-20; alarm-only ceiling for durable project and scenario state, never auto-prune.

database_wal.rationale: Live SQLite WAL sidecar; retained with the database and never removed while it is open.

budget.rationale: Measured at 0 bytes on 2026-10-20; alarm-only ceiling for the live WAL sidecar, never remove while SQLite is open.

database_shm.rationale: Live SQLite shared-memory sidecar; retained with the database and never removed while it is open.

budget.rationale: Measured at 32,768 bytes on 2026-10-20; alarm-only ceiling for the live shared-memory sidecar, never remove while SQLite is open.

deployment_reports.rationale: Retained lifecycle deployment decisions and verification reports under the scenario data root.

budget.rationale: Measured at 5,469 bytes on 2026-10-20; alarm-only ceiling for retained lifecycle deployment evidence, never auto-prune.

retention_receipt.rationale: Durable control-plane receipt documenting storage retention enforcement for this scenario.

budget.rationale: Measured at 147 bytes on 2026-10-20; alarm-only ceiling for durable enforcement evidence, never auto-prune.

storage.rationale: Device Studio owns durable project and example-domain data in SQLite and retained lifecycle deployment evidence. SQLite and deployment records are source state and have no automatic prune budget.
